title: Cumulative Price Index
scenario: Construct the price trajectory string for each product (e.g., '10->20->30') considering the initial price of 10.
tableSchema: products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE)
hint: Use STRING_AGG to build the path.
correctQuery: SELECT product_id, '10->' || STRING_AGG(new_price::text, '->' ORDER BY change_date) AS price_path FROM products GROUP BY product_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE);
